localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Subtle, unaligned vertical linear marks detected crossing the white pigmentation patch on the left lobe (viewer perspective).

other_distinctive_markers: Extreme granularity of the pigmentation pattern, exhibiting a salt-and-pepper distribution rather than distinct solid boundaries.
